title: Adding the extra gold lot when the fall accelerates, on a rebound, when deep or back above the 20-week MA — no timing separates; extra lots on accelerating falls cut the average cost a little and add to the loss in the bad episodes
question: During a gold decline, does a week with an accelerating fall, a rebound start, a deep drawdown or a move back above the 20-week MA have a better forward return than an ordinary decline week — i.e. is it a better week for the extra lot?
hypothesis: Trader's view: when the fall accelerates, or a rebound starts, add two lots instead of one.

findings.title: No add-on timing separates from an ordinary week in a decline
findings.detail: Against all weeks ≥10% below the high (2,215 weeks; 26-week mean +2.73%): accelerating fall +5.36% (255 weeks, 56 episodes, effect +2.64, bound 12.60); rebound start +6.65% (60 weeks, 38 episodes, +3.93, bound 24.81); deep ≥20% +2.00% (−0.73, bound 5.90); back above the 20-week MA +3.91% (+1.18, bound 17.04). Signs lean positive for C1, C2 and C4 at 13 and 26 weeks.
findings.title_zh: 沒有一種補倉時機能和下跌中的一般週分開

findings.title: Extra lots on accelerating falls lower the average cost a little and add to the loss when the decline continues
findings.detail: 26 weekly lots from each 25% event, plus one extra lot when C1 fires: average cost lower by 0.6-1.4% in the five past episodes, 26-week return better by 0.3-3.1 points. In lot-equivalents at 52 weeks it was worse in 1975 (−4.05 vs −3.44), 1980 (−5.86 vs −4.72) and 2013 (−1.32 vs −1.06), better in 1973 and 2008. In 2026 (from 2026-03-16) C1 fired 9 times and the average cost was slightly higher (4,410.87 vs 4,408.98).
findings.title_zh: 跌勢加速時多買，均價略低，但跌勢延續時虧更多

findings.title: This week meets the accelerating-fall and deep conditions
findings.detail: Week of 2026-10-19: close 3993.69, -24.33% from the high-close, 4-week -6.85%, 20-week MA 4229.95. C1 true, C3 true, C2 and C4 false.
findings.title_zh: 這週符合「跌勢加速」與「跌深」

card_summary: No add-on timing beats an ordinary decline week; buying extra on accelerating falls trims the average cost and enlarges the loss when the decline keeps going.
title_zh: 補倉時機：跌勢加速、開始反彈、跌深、站回 20 週線，都和一般下跌週分不開；加速時多買均價略低，但續跌時虧更多
question_zh: 黃金下跌期間，跌勢加速、開始反彈、跌深、站回 20 週線的那一週，之後的報酬是否比一般下跌週好？也就是說，多補的那一口該放哪一週？
hypothesis_zh: 交易者的想法：跌深的力道增加，或開始有反彈跡象時，可以補兩口。
card_summary_zh: 沒有補倉時機比一般下跌週好；跌勢加速時多買只讓均價略低，續跌時虧損更大。
limitations_zh: 只用週收盤；名目美元；沒有持有成本、轉倉、手續費。
未來報酬視窗互相重疊，反彈與均線條件在 52 週只有很少的獨立樣本。
試算只有過去 5 次事件，2026 年這次還沒結束。
interpretation_zh: 沒有一個時機明顯比較好，所以「哪一週多補」不太重要，重要的是「總共補多少」。跌勢加速時多買，均價只低 1% 左右，但在續跌的那幾次（1975、1980、2013）口數變多，虧損跟著變大，和 K-ACC-007 的結論一樣。反彈訊號和站回 20 週線略偏正，但樣本太少。實際上，如果要多補，與其挑時機，不如先決定在最壞情況（像 1980）下總共能承受幾口，並設好減碼線。
